adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` is computed via `guests.filter(...)` but never normalizes case and never deduplicates within the `guests` array. The checks `guest === attendee.email` and `blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` are case-sensitive, so mixed-case emails can bypass both existing-attendee filtering and the blacklist. Also, duplicate strings in `guests` will survive the filter and be passed to `attendees.createMany`, potentially creating duplicate attendee rows (or causing a DB constraint error). The client dialog refines uniqueness, but the server schema (`addGuests.schema.ts`) does not, so the API can be called with duplicates directly.
